source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Copy the monitoring records into an Excel spreadsheet by cell.
3. Write and check formulas to calculate Free Air Carbon (FAC), RATA standard deviation (RSD) and FAC factor.
4. Import Excel data into an ArcMap geodatabase.
5. Import GIS files and design a layout for the report.
6. Create an emissions trend line using the FAC summary results.
7. Create a statistical confidence interval diagram showing the deviation from an air-quality standard for each monitoring event.
8. Create a pie chart showing the sources of FAC on any particular day.
9. Copy and paste the data output from Excel and the confidence interval diagrams into your air-quality report.
